perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Cumulative primary evidence continues to support Thacker Pass as a strategically relevant domestic lithium build approaching peak construction, backed by strategic and convertible capital.
A bounded fresh issuer-domain search produced no materially newer primary disclosure than the retained August financing/construction update; no novelty is manufactured.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Execution remains construction-to-commissioning conversion; designed 40,000 tpa capacity and financing are not substitutes for realized output, qualification or operating economics.
Highest-value next evidence remains physical completion/commissioning progress and updated contingency or cost disclosure.

unknowns: remaining contingency versus total project cost
commissioning curve and realized operating cost
